title: The 4 Best Automatic Pet Feeders for Vacations
h1: The 4 Best Automatic Pet Feeders for Vacations
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for automatic pet feeders for vacations, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at automatic pet feeders for vacations using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: PetSafe Smart Feed Automatic Dog & Cat Feeder
products.blurb: Key specs: 24-cup / 6L hopper capacity, Wi-Fi app control with low-food alerts, Backup batteries maintain schedule through power outages.
strengths: 24-cup hopper covers most single-cat trips of two weeks or more without a refill
Backup batteries mean a power blip doesn't silently break the whole schedule
Low-food and completed-feeding alerts land directly on your phone while traveling
limitations: No camera, so alerts confirm dispensing but not that the pet actually ate
Requires a stable home Wi-Fi connection for remote alerts to work
Large housing takes up more counter space than a compact non-connected feeder
features: Wi-Fi app control with low-food alerts
Backup batteries maintain schedule through power outages
Up to 12 scheduled meals per day
Alexa compatible for manual snack dispensing

products.name: PETLIBRO Granary Camera Feeder with AI Multi-Pet Recognition
products.blurb: Key specs: 1080p camera with night vision, Two-way audio to check in and hear your pet, AI recognition and daily activity summaries per pet.
strengths: Live camera lets you actually see your pet eating, not just infer it from a dispensing alert
Two-way audio means you can talk to an anxious pet from anywhere
Daily activity summaries flag if a pet's eating pattern changes mid-trip
limitations: Cloud video storage for reviewing past footage requires a paid subscription
Smaller hopper than the PetSafe Smart Feed, better suited to trips under a week
Camera and Wi-Fi dependent, more points of failure than a simple mechanical timer
features: Two-way audio to check in and hear your pet
AI recognition and daily activity summaries per pet

products.name: PETLIBRO Granary 5L Wi-Fi Automatic Pet Feeder
strengths: App scheduling for up to 10 meals a day
5-liter hopper lasts several days for one cat or small dog
Battery backup keeps scheduled meals running during power cuts
limitations: Needs a 2.4/5 GHz Wi-Fi setup for remote features
Portion size varies with kibble shape

products.name: WOPET 7L Automatic Feeder with Camera
strengths: Built-in HD camera to watch mealtimes
App scheduling up to 6 meals a day
limitations: Camera features depend on the app

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
